claim: For every fixed grading exponent \(r>0\), the exact Manià energy of the nodal piecewise-affine interpolant of \(u_*(x)=x^{1/3}\) on \(x_i=(i/N)^r\) satisfies \(\mathcal I[I_N^{(r)}]=N^r\sum_{i=1}^N i^{-r}F(((i-1)/i)^r)\sim C_rN^r\), where \(F(\rho)=s(\rho)^6\int_\rho^1(\phi_\rho(t)^3-t)^2dt\), \(s(\rho)=(1-\rho^{1/3})/(1-\rho)\), \(\phi_\rho(t)=\rho^{1/3}+s(\rho)(t-\rho)\), and \(C_r=\sum_{i=1}^\infty i^{-r}F(((i-1)/i)^r)\in(0,\infty)\). In particular, \(\mathcal I[I_N^{(r)}]\ge(8/105)N^r\).

integrity: The all-r asymptotic follows from an exact cell-scaling identity and a Taylor expansion; finite numerical checks are supplementary only.
The uniform-mesh case is prior work and is not claimed as new.
limitations: The result concerns only nodal piecewise-affine interpolation on fixed power-graded meshes, not discrete minimizers or arbitrary mesh families.
The leading coefficient is an explicit convergent series rather than an elementary closed form.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.residual_priority_risk: Equivalent graded-mesh asymptotics outside the inspected literature cannot be ruled out.

title: Exact energy growth on power-graded meshes for Manià's singular minimizer
